title: Commercial robot incidents: The Machine Record
subtitle: Robotaxi, delivery, industrial and humanoid robot incidents, 1979 to today
description: Mirror of the public register at https://themachinerecord.com. One row per documented incident involving a commercial physical robot, with a permanent case page carrying the timeline and archived sources. Case metadata is CC BY 4.0. Not a safety rating: fleet sizes are not public. Quarterly research releases with a codebook; see the GitHub repository vzolot/machine-record-data.

resources.description: One row per published case, 24 columns
Timeline events, one row per event
Sources with tier, independence, language and archived copy
News cases linked to NHTSA SGO filings
